name: web-development
description: Conventions and tools for full-stack TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepos (Express 5 + Kysely + Postgres, Vite/Next frontends) deployed to a VPS with PM2 + nginx: monorepo scaffolding, API conventions, env var sync check, release pipeline, Markdown for agents (Accept: text/markdown negotiation), and an opt-in guard hook that blocks migrations and git commit/push.
